lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: The morning submission deadline is in thirty minutes. Why are you loitering outside my office instead of preparing your final submission?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I'm heading back to the publication office right now, Sir.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Where is the Master Portfolio? I asked for the final print, not empty hands. Go get the document.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Right away, Sir. The proof is on the desk.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: You’re exactly on time. I assume this 'Master Zine' is as perfect as you claimed it would be?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: See for yourself, Sir. Every margin is aligned, the typographic hierarchy is strictly enforced, and the reporting is accurate.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: The layout... it's immaculate. You didn't just write stories; you gave them the discipline and structure they deserved.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Consider your clearance signed. The Paragon still has a place at Likha High.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Thank you, Sir. We won't let you down.

lines.speaker: Mr. Reyes
lines.text: Your clearance has been approved. Go celebrate with your editorial team.
